title: GitHub Organization Teams Catalog Schema
description: Validates centralized GitHub Team definitions and Entra ID IdP group mappings in config/orgs/<org>/teams.yaml.

slug.description: Immutable kebab-case team slug used for @org/<slug> references across repository files.

name.description: Display name of the GitHub Team.

description.description: Clear description of the team's responsibilities and domain scope.

privacy.description: Team visibility within the organization ('closed' is required so teams can be nested and referenced in CODEOWNERS).

role_tier.description: Governance persona tier for this team.

parent_team.description: Optional slug of the parent GitHub Team within the same organization.

idp_group_id.description: Optional Entra ID (Azure AD) Group Object ID synchronized via Enterprise Team Sync / SCIM.

maintainers.description: Optional explicit GitHub usernames with team maintainer role (when not solely IdP-synced).

members.description: Optional explicit GitHub usernames with team member role (prefer idp_group_id where possible).
